# Above 95% test coverage for all integration modules

Source: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/integration-quality-scale/rules/test-coverage
Retrieved: 2026-08-15

Home Assistant cannot hands-on test every device or service. Integrations
need good test coverage so code changes do not introduce regressions.

There are no exceptions to this rule.

Related: config-flow-test-coverage.
